summary: A sample bookings platform. Customers book through the web and mobile apps; one **core API** holds the business logic as modules; operations staff work in the back office. Production runs in two AWS regions, with payments and SMS through partners.

actors.name: Customer
actors.description: Books and pays for appointments on the web or mobile app.

actors.name: Operations team
actors.description: Manages providers, refunds and support cases in the back office.

actors.name: Provider
actors.description: A clinic or practitioner who receives bookings through the provider portal.

externals.name: Twilio
externals.description: SMS one-time codes and booking reminders.

externals.name: Google Maps
externals.description: Address search and distance for provider listings.

regions.name: Europe (production)
regions.description: Primary region. Serves every market outside the Gulf.

resources.name: CloudFront
resources.description: Serves the web apps and caches public API reads.

resources.name: Web bucket
resources.description: Static builds of the web app and back office.

resources.name: ECS cluster
resources.description: Runs the core API and the reminder job.

resources.name: Bookings database
resources.description: System of record for bookings, providers and payments.

resources.name: Events queue
resources.description: Booking events for reminders and reporting.

regions.name: Gulf (production)
regions.description: Data residency region for Gulf customers. Same layout as Europe without a CDN bucket.

containers.name: Core API
containers.description: The one backend: bookings, providers, payments and notifications as modules.

containers.name: Back office
containers.description: Operations console for providers, refunds and support.

containers.name: Reminder job
containers.description: Reads booking events and sends reminders a day ahead.

modules.name: Auth
modules.description: Sign-in with phone and one-time code; issues JWTs.

endpoints.summary: Verify the code and issue tokens
Create a booking and hold the slot

modules.name: Payments
modules.description: Card payments and refunds through the payment adapter.

adapters.name: Stripe adapter
adapters.description: Implements the PaymentGateway port with Stripe PaymentIntents.

adapters.name: SMS adapter
adapters.description: Sends SMS through Twilio Messaging Services.

flows.title: Book and pay
flows.description: A customer picks a slot, pays by card, and gets an SMS confirmation.
flows.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant C as Customer app
  participant B as Bookings
  participant P as Payments
  participant S as Stripe
  participant N as Notifications
  C->>B: POST /bookings
  B->>P: create payment intent
  P->>S: PaymentIntent
  S-->>P: webhook succeeded
  P-->>B: payment.succeeded
  B-->>N: booking.created
  N-->>C: SMS confirmation

flows.title: Sign in with a one-time code
flows.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  A[Phone number] --> B[POST /auth/otp]
  B --> C[SMS code]
  C --> D[POST /auth/verify]
  D --> E[Access and refresh tokens]
